description: Narrow this session's memory to one project: name='<slug>' scopes recall, the wake bundle, self-notes and the default namespace for new facts to project:<slug>:* (identity and conventions always ride along). Returns the narrowed bundle right away. name='' widens back to the whole account. Sticky for the session and across reconnects; bind_agent is unaffected. The same call ENTERS a workspace someone shared with this account: name='<their name>' (or their tenant id, or the granted prefix, as listed by list_workspaces) switches this connection into it; no second server, no header, no restart; it holds for the session. name='' leaves it for the session. HOME WORKSPACE: remember=true also makes it this account's home, so every new session starts inside it; switch_workspace(name='', forget=true) forgets the home. An account with no facts of its own and exactly one shared workspace starts inside that workspace automatically. list_workspaces and wake_status show the home and how this session entered (home, tool or header). When a person asks to work in someone else's shared memory, call this.

forget.description: With name='': also forget the home workspace, so new sessions start in your own account (the automatic home included).

name.description: Project slug (the <slug> in project:<slug>:*), the name of a granted workspace to enter (from list_workspaces), or '' to widen / leave.

remember.description: With a granted workspace's name: also make it the home workspace, entered at the start of every new session.

name: switch_workspace
title: Switch Workspace
